_meta.scopeNote: naming.v1.json idNamespaces.affixFamilies lists g.ward's existingFamilies as elemental_defense, stoicism, padding, stalwart, immunity, susceptibility (6). susceptibility is deliberately OMITTED from this file: atom-family-library.md §3.2 states status.expose.* is 'declared with zero readers today, so not authored at all until it has a consumer' — the atom row itself does not exist, so an item affix referencing atom.susceptibility would be a forward reference to nothing (seed-contract.md §7.1 forbids exactly that). This is a read finding, not a guess: ssot-affixes.md §4.1's own g.ward row is what lists susceptibility as 'live today: quarantined', and quarantined-but-authored (D6) is a different state from not-authored-at-all. Two new families (atom.ward-harden, atom.ward-brace) fill the resulting gap back to ~7.

entries.name: Elemental Ward
entries.notes: SHIPPED, id kept verbatim per naming.v1.json idNamespaces.affixFamilies (g.ward existingFamilies). channel/op mirror atom-family-library.md §3.2's own worked row ('+10 fire resist' -> stat.derived/elemental_defense/channel combat.defense.fire) and element-hub-ssot.md's shipped aggregation table (combat.defense.{element} is a flat-sum channel). `nameWords.prefix` reuses the SAME six canonical elemental adjectives the doc itself ties to this exact family (atom-family-library.md §3.2: 'Ember/Frost/Gale/Stone/Radiant/Umbral ...Ward', the mirror image of elemental_power's '...Power'), not an accidental collision with another partition's pool. QUARANTINE: stat.derived is quarantined None/None/None (D6, atom-family-library.md §3.2) -- no runtime executes this channel until E12's BattleStatComposer. Roles are the g.ward column of ssot-affixes.md §4.3's role x group matrix, translated from the stale 12-role table to core.v1.json's 15 ids the same way the g.on-hit sibling did (head-protective->head-guard, sense-utility->sense, core-protective->core-guard, mantle-utility->mantle, manipulator-offense excluded at weight 0, girdle-resource excluded at weight 0, jewel-minor->jewel-minor-a and jewel-minor-b, armament-primary excluded at weight 0). `standard` carries weight 2 in that row (unlike g.on-hit's 0) and is included per naming.v1.json's baseTypes.commanderStandardAddendum, which names 'standard' as a legal affix-lane role and elemental_defense already resolves per-actor (atom-family-library.md §4.1), unlike warding/resilience's match-scoped-only restriction -- flagged here in case a reviewer reads that addendum as g.armour-specific only.

entries.name: Stoicism
entries.notes: SHIPPED, id kept verbatim. Channel confirmed element-varying by element-hub-ssot.md's aggregation table (combat.crit.resist.{element}, flat sum) and by atom-family-library.md §3.2 grouping it with the 12 element-generated stat.derived families, not the 4 status-channel ones. No canonical flavour-by-element word set is documented for this family (unlike elemental_power/elemental_defense's shared Ember/Frost/... set), so `nameWords` is minted here -- deliberately non-elemental-adjective vocabulary (weathering, numbness, rootedness) so this file's seven entries don't cluster on one idea. QUARANTINE: stat.derived, D6, same as above.

entries.name: Padding
entries.notes: SHIPPED, id kept verbatim. Channel confirmed by element-hub-ssot.md (combat.crit.resist.damage.{element}, flat sum, feeds 'Crit magnitude'), distinct from stoicism's crit-CHANCE-resist channel just above -- this family softens the hit once a crit already lands. `nameWords` minted (husk/cushion/insulation imagery: a padded, absorbing surface rather than a hardened one, to keep this entry distinct from stoicism and from the two new hardening-flavoured families below). QUARANTINE: stat.derived, D6.

entries.name: Stalwart
entries.notes: SHIPPED, id kept verbatim. One of atom-family-library.md §3.2's 4 status-channel families ('not element-expanded') -- no `variants` block, matching how the g.on-hit sibling omitted `variants`/`element` for atom.lifesteal. The real shipped channel is the open-ended prefix `status.resist.{id}` against the locked 21-status catalog (atom-catalog-ssot.md), but WHICH status id a rolled atom targets is a generation-time/tier concern this partition has no visibility into (that catalog belongs to the effect-atom program, not item wave-1a) -- `channel` is written at the family level (`status.resist`) rather than guessing a specific status id. Flagging this rather than inventing a status id is the deliberate choice; a reviewer with the status catalog in hand may need to add the `{id}` segment later. QUARANTINE: stat.derived, D6.

entries.name: Immunity
entries.displayTemplate: {value}% chance to shrug off a status affliction outright
entries.notes: SHIPPED, id kept verbatim. Second of the 4 status-channel families; the real shipped channel is the open-ended `status.immune.{tag}` -- same 'family-level channel, tag left to a later generation step' treatment as stalwart just above, for the same reason (the tag catalog is out of this partition's scope). `op: Flag` (not Flat) because a complete block reads as a boolean gate rather than an additive resist number, and derived ops explicitly include Flag alongside Flat/Increased/Replace (atom-family-library.md §2a). `powerBand: high` is the one relative-strength judgement this entry makes: an outright block is a stronger pull than stalwart's partial resist, the same kind of sibling-strength call the exemplar makes between elemental_power and elpw-amplify. QUARANTINE: stat.derived, D6.

entries.name: Calcified Hide
entries.notes: NEW family, stem `ward` (naming.v1.json idNamespaces.affixFamilies), word `harden` -- short and mechanical. Mints the Increased sibling combat.defense.{variant} does not yet have, the exact same split the exemplar itself demonstrates for combat.power.* (atom.elemental-power Flat + atom.elpw-amplify Increased): Flat adds resolver points, Increased scales them, and they compose differently against everything else on the actor. `powerBand: low` against elemental-defense's `medium` mirrors elpw-amplify's judgement against elemental_power for the identical reason. Decay/bone imagery (calcify, ossify, fossilize) rather than reusing the Ember/Frost/... set, both for variety and because this family is untyped-by-flavour (an Increased multiplier, not a named elemental substance). QUARANTINE: stat.derived, D6, same as its Flat sibling -- authored now, bound nowhere until E12.

entries.name: Graftplate
entries.displayTemplate: cannot be critically struck by {element} damage
entries.notes: NEW family, stem `ward`, word `brace`. Fills the one on-hit-defense combination the shipped roster leaves open on combat.crit.resist.*: stoicism is a Flat numeric resist, this is a Flag -- an outright per-element crit immunity, the same shape distinction immunity (Flag on status.immune) makes against stalwart (Flat on status.resist) two entries above, applied to the crit-resist channel instead of the status channel. `powerBand: low` keeps a binary immunity from outclassing stoicism's partial, always-on resist -- a hard gate is worth less per point of item budget than a number that always applies. Graft/bark/chitin imagery keeps this in the fusion register (plant graft plus a hardened zombie/insect plate) rather than reusing calcify/ossify from ward-harden just above. QUARANTINE: stat.derived, D6.
